server.py startup seed is idempotent (upsert by username) and calls db.users.delete_many({'username': {'$nin': valid_usernames}}) so all stale accounts from prior iterations are automatically removed.

server.py build_price_payload filters strictly by authorized_columns(role); COST columns E–H are never reachable for any role.
